description: Publish a sandbox port and return a browser-ready preview URL. Private ports receive an expiring signed URL; public ports receive a clean URL, and unpublished ports remain closed. This does not verify that a process is listening (start one with sandbox_exec, e.g. `python3 -m http.server 8000`).

expires_in_seconds.description: Private signed-link lifetime in seconds (default 3600, max 604800 = 7 days). Ignored for public previews.

port.description: The port a process is (or will be) listening on.

name: sandbox_preview_url
title: Publish a port and get its preview URL
